summary: Webull Corp, a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, reporting its financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release and an investor presentation as exhibits, and incorporates the report by reference into its existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. The filing contains routine financial disclosures and forward-looking statements but no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a standard periodic earnings report, not a special situation.
